newsitem.title: USA: Solucorp, Smart Int'l in licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: Solucorp, Smart Int'l in licensing pact.

text.p: Solucorp Industries Ltd said Thursday that Hong Kong-based Smart International Ltd has signed an exclusive licensing contract for the rights to produce, market and apply the company's Molecular Bonding System in China.

The company said the contract, which spans a minimum of five years, provides it with an initial license fee of $2 million during the first year. Additional annual fees and royalties on the use of MBS on projects, said Solucorp, are to be agreed upon after completion of a detailed market survey which is to be completed in two months.
Smart International has been a supplier of Solucorp's chemicals since April, said the company.
Solucorp is develops products which solve the needs of environmental markets.
